scope: Beta=3 larger-size extension, specified before reading any new-size production mean
size_decision: Pilot timing and variance may determine whether L=42 is practical; do not choose sizes by agreement with a scaling law
sampling: Original symmetric E/S swap, four independent starts, one measurement per sweep; pilot excluded from production
allocation: Freeze burnin and production length after pilot convergence/cost/variance assessment; minimum 2048 retained sweeps per chain
fit_windows: Report each eligible lower cut with all sizes through the largest completed planned size; also retain Lmax=24 comparisons
parameter_errors: Known estimated MCSE WLS covariance, never multiplied by reduced chi square; statistical errors exclude model/window bias
local_slopes: Report both delta D / delta ln L and delta D / delta L, their full propagated covariance, and prespecified width-six intervals when both endpoints exist
inference: Neither an isolated good fit nor two flat adjacent slopes establish an asymptotic law; compare residuals, cut drift and raw slopes without discarding inconvenient points
outputs: Separate beta3_large analysis/figure directories; preserve all previous frozen production and analysis outputs
